subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin suggested firing a fireball at the trees.
source_quote: Thorin's suggestion was to fireball the trees.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz announced, 'I'm going to misty step up into the tree.'
source_quote: I'm going to misty step up into the tree," Daz announced.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'It's very rude to follow people without just coming up and talking to them. So we'll talk to you now.'
source_quote: "It's very rude," he said, which is the most Daz thing I've heard him say, possibly ever, "to follow people without just coming up and talking to them. So we'll talk to you now."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum asked, 'Are you looking for a new job? We could use another helper.'
source_quote: "Hey," he said, with the casual tone of someone considering a minor administrative matter, "are you looking for a new job? We could use another helper."

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum handed her prayer beads and said, 'Put them on.'
source_quote: Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on.

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir asked, 'Who are you? Why are you following us? Are you a friend or foe?'
source_quote: "Who are you? Why are you following us? Are you a friend or foe?"

subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir said, 'I have no particular desire to kill you, unless you mean us harm.'
source_quote: "I have no particular desire to kill you," Zalthir said, "unless you mean us harm."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'We could simply let her go — report her failure to her matron, let them know how pathetic you are.'
source_quote: He walked up and told her we could simply let her go — report her failure to her matron, "let them know how pathetic you are."

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin said, 'Probably not feeling so lucky right now.'
source_quote: "Probably not feeling so lucky right now," Thorin said.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz asked, 'Why am I so important that you're trying hard not to make it look like you're following me, but you're following me?'
source_quote: "So we may be able to figure something out where you live, but first you need to answer some questions. Why am I so important that you're trying hard not to make it look like you're following me, but you're following me?"

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'I am of House T'sarran. I will not give my name. Take my piwafwi if you want a trophy. My matron will know one of hers fell out here, and that is enough.'
source_quote: "I am of House T'sarran. I will not give my name. Take my piwafwi if you want a trophy. My matron will know one of hers fell out here, and that is enough."

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'I was just assigned to track you, not to engage. My orders were to report your surface destination, your contact, who approaches you.'
source_quote: "I was just assigned to track you, not to engage. My orders were to report your surface destination, your contact, who approaches you."

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'My matron believes that the one who paid —' and here she pointed at me, with the resigned precision of someone who has run out of misdirection — 'for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you.'
source_quote: "My matron believes that the one who paid —" and here she pointed at me, with the resigned precision of someone who has run out of misdirection — "for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you."

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'The matron mother cares, and therefore I care.'
source_quote: "The matron mother cares, and therefore I care."

subject: surface forest
fact: The bird call came just as I was settling in for the night — not a real bird — that was the point. A cardinal's whistle, clean and bright, floating through tree cover that hadn't seen a cardinal in decades, maybe ever.
source_quote: The bird call came just as I was settling in for the night. Not a real bird — that was the point. A cardinal's whistle, clean and bright, floating through tree cover that hadn't seen a cardinal in decades, maybe ever.

subject: prayer beads
fact: Grygum handed her prayer beads — holy symbols of a deity she knew nothing about — and told her to put them on.
source_quote: Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on.

subject: piwafwi
fact: The drow spy offered her piwafwi as a trophy if they wanted it.
source_quote: Take my piwafwi if you want a trophy.

subject: underdark
fact: Months in the Underdark will calibrate your instincts. You learn to notice the shape of a threat before you can name it.
source_quote: Months in the Underdark will calibrate your instincts. You learn to notice the shape of a threat before you can name it.

subject: surface
fact: The drow was assigned to track the party on the surface, in daylight hours, following quietly instead of attacking.
source_quote: drow, on the surface, daylight hours, following us quietly instead of attacking.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool made a sound like a bag of wet sand dropped from a significant height while also being squeezed.
source_quote: It was the sound a bag of wet sand might make if someone dropped it from a significant height while also squeezing it.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool asked, 'Is it a kind of ooze?'
source_quote: "Is it a kind of ooze?" he asked, in that way he has, earnest and completely serious about the question.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'They're not oozy at all. They're feathered.'
source_quote: "No, no," I said, "they're not oozy at all. They're feathered."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'I want to get some intel out of this,' in the way a man says a thing when he's already decided what he's going to do.
source_quote: "I want to get some intel out of this," he said, the way a man says a thing when he's already decided what he's going to do.

subject: Someone
fact: Someone speculated it might be Jimjar, coming to drag us back underground.
source_quote: Someone speculated it might be Jimjar, coming to drag us back underground.

subject: north of the road
fact: North of the road, something that was not a deer held its position and waited.
source_quote: North of the road, something that was not a deer held its position and waited.

subject: dusk
fact: The dusk settled around us.
source_quote: The dusk settled around us.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'You realize how absurd that sounds?'
source_quote: "You realize how absurd that sounds?"

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy said, 'My matron had ruled House T'sarran for two hundred years.'
source_quote: She told us her matron had ruled House T'sarran for two hundred years.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'Let me correct that. I've been away from home for a while.'
source_quote: "Let me just put it this way. Let me correct that. I've been away from home for a while."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'So basically, you're treating me as bait. You're watching and observing so that when something happens to me, you can go report back what happened to me.'
source_quote: "So basically, you're treating me as bait. You're watching and observing so that when something happens to me, you can go report back what happened to me."

subject: Daz
fact: Daz said, 'Because we are looking for the one who paid to have you protected.'
source_quote: "Because we are looking for the one who paid to have you protected."

subject: Blinddenstone
fact: Daz was running on whatever sleep they'd managed in Blingdenstone.
source_quote: I am not, technically speaking, accustomed to conducting interrogations in full sunlight while running on whatever sleep we'd managed in Blingdenstone.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum rolled persuasion, and she talked.
source_quote: Then Grygum rolled persuasion, and she talked.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum looked at the drow and saw the whole picture at once: the surface posting, the miserable exposure to the overbright, the desperate bravado of someone who'd drawn a terrible assignment and was trying to make it look like a choice.
source_quote: He looked at her and I think he saw the whole picture at once: the surface posting, the miserable exposure to the overbright, the desperate bravado of someone who'd drawn a terrible assignment and was trying to make it look like a choice.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy stared at Thorin with the blank patience of someone waiting for the world to start making sense again.
source_quote: She stared at him with the blank patience of someone waiting for the world to start making sense again.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy laughed in Thorin's face.
source_quote: He tried again. She laughed in his face.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was small — Grygum's Reduce spell had seen to that — but she held herself with the trained dignity of someone who understood that posture was its own kind of armor.
source_quote: She was small — Grygum's Reduce spell had seen to that — but she held herself with the trained dignity of someone who understood that posture was its own kind of armor.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was watching Daz, and working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.
source_quote: She wasn't watching the party. She was watching me. And working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was stunned, grappled, shrunk, and laughed at by a dwarf.
source_quote: She had been stunned and grappled and shrunk and laughed at by a dwarf.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was grappled and stunned, held in place with the kind of efficient finality that Zalthir brings to everything he considers a problem worth solving immediately.
source_quote: The spy — drow, slight, female, exactly as advertised — was grappled and stunned, held in place with the kind of efficient finality that Zalthir brings to everything he considers a problem worth solving immediately.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was wearing prayer beads around her neck.
source_quote: The beads were still around her neck.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was assigned by her matron to track the party on the surface, not to engage.
source_quote: I was just assigned to track you, not to engage.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was following the party because her matron believed the one who paid to protect Daz would reveal themselves once he reached the surface.
source_quote: My matron believes that the one who paid — for him, will reveal themselves once he reaches the surface. We are looking for that person, not for you.

subject: Drow Spy
fact: The drow spy was not an assassin — she was someone who got handed a bad assignment and was making the best of it.
source_quote: That combination doesn't say assassin to me. It says someone who got handed a bad assignment and is making the best of it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was climbing down from the tree.
source_quote: Daz was already climbing down from the tree.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was tying up the drow spy while speaking to her.
source_quote: He said it while tying her up.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was watching the drow spy's face for what it told him.
source_quote: I stood back and let him work, watching the spy's face for what it told me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was thinking about the drow who had been following them from the north — careful, close, twenty or forty feet.
source_quote: Thorin had picked up something in the terrain earlier — movement from the north, not panicked, not aggressive, careful. Close. Twenty, maybe forty feet.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was thinking about the drow, and the difference between a predator and a professional doing a job they'd rather not be doing.
source_quote: There's a difference between a predator and someone doing a job they'd rather not be doing, and I've learned to read that difference fast.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was taking notes.
source_quote: I took notes. It's what I do.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was remembering a training instructor's maxim: 'The first rule of the House: know who holds the debt before you decide whether to collect it.'
source_quote: I thought of something a training instructor had said once, after a particularly messy exercise in leverage: *The first rule of the House: know who holds the debt before you decide whether to collect it.*

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was aware that the drow spy was not watching the party — she was watching him.
source_quote: She wasn't watching the party. She was watching me. And working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz was not technically accustomed to conducting interrogations in full sunlight.
source_quote: I am not, technically speaking, accustomed to conducting interrogations in full sunlight while running on whatever sleep we'd managed in Blingdenstone.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had been away from home for a while.
source_quote: Let me correct that. I've been away from home for a while.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had been underground for a while.
source_quote: I'm drow, but I've been underground for a while.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had run the same arithmetic at Velkynvelve, the first morning, when a wrong answer meant a crossbow bolt.
source_quote: I recognized it because I had run the same numbers at Velkynvelve, the first morning, when a wrong answer meant a crossbow bolt.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had been hunted, chased, contracted against, and ambushed enough times in the last several months to develop opinions about being followed.
source_quote: Someone who was very good at staying invisible to anyone not actively looking for them, and not quite good enough to stay invisible to a party that had been hunted, chased, contracted against, and ambushed enough times in the last several months to develop opinions about being followed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's composure fracture when Grygum offered survival.
source_quote: Something shifted in her face. A tiny, involuntary fracture in the composure. *Wait. I might live?*

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noticed that the drow spy was young enough, or tired enough, or unhappy enough with her assignment, that the offer of survival caught her genuinely off guard.
source_quote: She was young enough, or tired enough, or perhaps just unhappy enough with her assignment, that the offer of survival caught her genuinely off guard.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had observed that the prayer beads were the thing that actually broke through the professional armor.
source_quote: The beads were the thing that actually broke through the professional armor.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's assessment of the situation entirely reorganize itself when presented with unknown religious ritual from an alien faith.
source_quote: Unknown religious ritual from an alien faith, administered by a half-orc? That slipped right past every prepared defense.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had watched the drow spy's face as she realized she might live.
source_quote: I watched the concept try to find somewhere to settle and fail to locate purchase.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had felt the same feeling once, when a teacher of his described a maxim as something that tells you what you're doing rather than what to do.
source_quote: I'd had the same feeling, once, when a teacher of mine described a maxim as something that tells you what you're doing rather than what to do — I'd turned it over for three days before it clicked.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had believed, provisionally, that the divine plan has us covered.
source_quote: The divine plan has us covered, in the broadest possible sense — or at least I choose to believe it does, provisionally, and correct the belief when the evidence demands it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noticed the drow spy was not a predator — she was a professional doing a job she'd rather not be doing.
source_quote: There's a difference between a predator and someone doing a job they'd rather not be doing, and I've learned to read that difference fast.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy's matron had ruled House T'sarran for two hundred years — old power, patient power.
source_quote: Old power. Patient power. The kind that waits.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had realized that the drow spy was being used as bait to draw out the one who paid to protect him.
source_quote: So basically, you're treating me as bait. You're watching and observing so that when something happens to me, you can go report back what happened to me.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had understood that the matron's interest was not in him — it was in the one who paid to have him protected.
source_quote: We are looking for that person, not for you.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had understood that the matron cared because the one who paid cared.
source_quote: The matron mother cares, and therefore I care.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy was not a warrior — she was a clerk of a matron who had ruled for two centuries.
source_quote: Not a house currently in crisis, not a young matron making aggressive plays to consolidate position. Old power. Patient power.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had observed that the drow spy's training had made her treat death as a preference, not a threat.
source_quote: The Menzoberranzan training is very thorough about creating a certain relationship to death: make it seem like a preference, not a threat.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had observed that the drow spy's composure was professional armor — and that the prayer beads had broken through it.
source_quote: A credible threat she understood — extraction, summary execution, reporting her failure up the chain — these were surfaces she had trained to hold against. Unknown religious ritual from an alien faith, administered by a half-orc? That slipped right past every prepared defense.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noticed that the drow spy's eyes were not on the party — they were on him.
source_quote: She wasn't watching the party. She was watching me. And working very, very hard to make it look like she wasn't.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had known the discipline of *not looking at the thing you are most interested in* from Menzoberranzan.
source_quote: The particular discipline of *not looking at the thing you are most interested in* is one of the first social skills anyone learns in the city.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had recognized the effort of that maintenance — the deliberate control — as legible to anyone who knows what they're looking at.
source_quote: The effort of that maintenance, that deliberate control, is itself legible to anyone who knows what they're looking at.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's face change when Grygum rolled persuasion.
source_quote: Then Grygum rolled persuasion, and she talked.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's expression shift from professional detachment to something more human — annoyance, frustration, defeat.
source_quote: She looked, in the GM's precise summary, defeated, frustrated, annoyed.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's body language change when she realized she might survive.
source_quote: Something shifted in her face. A tiny, involuntary fracture in the composure. *Wait. I might live?*

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had seen the drow spy's eyes linger on him — not as a target, but as a key.
source_quote: She pointed at me, with the resigned precision of someone who has run out of misdirection.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had understood that the drow spy was not the enemy — she was a pawn.
source_quote: She was not an assassin — she was someone who got handed a bad assignment and was making the best of it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had realized that the true enemy was the one who had paid to have him protected — and that the matron was hunting them.
source_quote: We are looking for that person, not for you.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had accepted that he was bait.
source_quote: So basically, you're treating me as bait.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had accepted that the matron cared because someone else had paid.
source_quote: The matron mother cares, and therefore I care.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been shrunk by Grygum's Reduce spell.
source_quote: She was small — Grygum's Reduce spell had seen to that.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been stunned and grappled by Zalthir.
source_quote: The spy — drow, slight, female, exactly as advertised — was grappled and stunned, held in place with the kind of efficient finality that Zalthir brings to everything he considers a problem worth solving immediately.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been laughed at by Thorin.
source_quote: She had been stunned and grappled and shrunk and laughed at by a dwarf.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been given prayer beads by Grygum.
source_quote: Grygum held out the prayer beads. He didn't say anything particularly ominous. He just handed them to her and told her to put them on.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been offered survival by Grygum.
source_quote: Hey, are you looking for a new job? We could use another helper.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been told she could be left in the full sun.
source_quote: Thorin floating the suggestion of leaving her out in the full sun in her current reduced state.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been told to give her piwafwi as a trophy.
source_quote: Take my piwafwi if you want a trophy.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been told she would be reported to her matron.
source_quote: My matron will know one of hers fell out here, and that is enough.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz had noted that the drow spy had been told her matron was waiting for them to surface.
source_quote: My matron was waiting for you to surface. She sent a couple of us up to the overbright to find where you were.
